p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid)
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==0]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    return [[grid[h-1-r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
''')
